interpretations: For each film rating, return the rating, the average `replacement_cost` of films with that rating, `AVG(rental_rate) / AVG(rental_duration)` for those films, and that rating’s per-day price divided by the arithmetic mean of the per-day prices across all ratings, counting each rating once. Do not round any result
queries:
WITH rating_prices AS (
  SELECT
    rating,
    AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost,
    AVG(rental_rate) / AVG(rental_duration) AS per_day_price
  FROM film
  GROUP BY rating
)
SELECT
  rating,
  avg_replacement_cost,
  per_day_price,
  per_day_price / AVG(per_day_price) OVER () AS relative_per_day_price
FROM rating_prices
